Three days later, Omar Awadallah, a foreign ministry official, said that those missions should also use the new name. Some of the countries themselves, such as Norway, Sweden and Spain, stick to the Palestinian Authority term even though they voted "in favor" of the UNGA resolution. Two days later, following negative Israel reaction, it was announced that the change will not apply to documents used at Israel checkpoints in the West Bank and Israeli crossings,  unless there is a further decision by Abbas.  Saeb Erekat then said the new emblem will be used in correspondence with countries that have recognized a state of Palestine. It claims sovereignty over the Palestinian territories, and has designated Jerusalem as its capital. ref label capital ii The areas claimed for the State of Palestine have been occupied by Israel since 1967 in the aftermath of the Six-Day War, with the Palestinian Authority exercising socio-political administration since 1993 in limited areas. The October 1974 Arab League summit designated the PLO as the "sole legitimate representative of the Palestinian people" and reaffirmed "their right to establish an independent state of urgency." In November, PLO was recognized as competent on all matters concerning the question of Palestine by the UN General Assembly granting them observer status as a "non-state entity" at the UN, After the 1988 Declaration of Independence, the UN General Assembly officially "acknowledged" the proclamation and decided to use the designation "Palestine" instead of "Palestine Liberation Organization" in the UN In spite of this decision, the PLO did not participate at the UN in its capacity of the State of Palestine s government. In 1993, in the Oslo Accords, Israel acknowledged the PLO negotiating team as "representing the Palestinian people", in return for the PLO recognizing Israel s right to exist in peace, acceptance of UN Security Council resolutions 242 and 338, and its rejection of "violence and terrorism". Murphy, Kim (10 September 1993).

conflict_sentences: It claims sovereignty over the Palestinian territories, and has designated Jerusalem as its capital. ref label capital ii In November 1974, the PLO was recognized as competent on all matters concerning the question of Palestine by the UN General Assembly granting them observer status as a "non-state entity" at the UN.  cite web title General Assembly: 3237 (XXIX).

It claims sovereignty over the Palestinian territories, and has designated Jerusalem as its capital. ref label capital ii In November 1974, the PLO was recognized as competent on all matters concerning the question of Palestine by the UN General Assembly granting them observer status as a "non-state entity" at the UN. After the 1988 Declaration of Independence, the UN General Assembly officially "acknowledged" the proclamation and decided to use the designation "Palestine" instead of "Palestine Liberation Organization" in the UN. In spite of this decision, the PLO did not participate at the UN in its capacity of the State of Palestine s government. In 1993, in the Oslo Accords, Israel acknowledged the PLO negotiating team as "representing the Palestinian people", in return for the PLO recognizing Israel s right to exist in peace, acceptance of UN Security Council resolutions 242 and 338, and its rejection of "violence and terrorism".  cite web first1 Kim last1 Murphy title Israel and PLO, in Historic Bid for Peace, Agree to Mutual Recognition : Mideast: After decades of conflict, accord underscores both sides readiness to coexist.

On 2013-09-21T03:11:49Z, Dlv999 reworded the introduction’s description of UN General Assembly Resolution 67/19 from implicitly recognizing the PLO’s right to represent the Palestinian people to implicitly recognizing PLO sovereignty.

full_context_edge_analyses.detailed_description: On 2013-09-20T13:03:19Z, AsceticRose reworded the lead's 1974 Arab League statement, replaced Etymology's 19th-century and British-Mandate account with an Ancient Greece and Herodotus account, and removed the Background sentence that the PNA gained full control of Gaza in 2005.

On 2013-09-21T02:55:44Z, Chicago Style (without pants) reworded the Etymology section to state that since the British Mandate, “Palestine” has been associated with the area now covering the State of Israel, the West Bank and Gaza Strip, and modern Jordan, rather than only the State of Israel, West Bank, and Gaza Strip.
On 2013-09-21T03:01:10Z, Malik Shabazz removed the modern state of Jordan from the Etymology statement describing the geographical area associated with Palestine since the British Mandate.

On 2013-09-21T03:03:26Z, Chicago Style (without pants) reworded the description of UN General Assembly resolution 67/19 to say that it implicitly recognized the PLO's right to represent the Palestinian people rather than PLO sovereignty.

On 2013-09-21T03:11:49Z, Dlv999 reworded the introduction’s description of UN General Assembly Resolution 67/19 from implicitly recognizing the PLO’s right to represent the Palestinian people to implicitly recognizing PLO sovereignty.

On 2013-09-21T03:01:10Z, Malik Shabazz removed the modern state of Jordan from the Etymology statement describing the geographical area associated with Palestine since the British Mandate.

On 2013-09-21T03:03:26Z, Chicago Style (without pants) reworded the description of UN General Assembly resolution 67/19 to say that it implicitly recognized the PLO's right to represent the Palestinian people rather than PLO sovereignty.

On 2013-09-21T03:11:49Z, Dlv999 reworded the introduction’s description of UN General Assembly Resolution 67/19 from implicitly recognizing the PLO’s right to represent the Palestinian people to implicitly recognizing PLO sovereignty.
